en.title: Employment Status
en.summary: The terms staff are employed on — permanent, contract, probation.

sections.heading: The two flags
sections.body:
• Remove From Employee Lists — staff with this status are left out of the employee pickers on forms, so nobody chooses them by mistake.
• Assigned to Terminated Employees — the status an employee is given when terminated. Only one status can carry it.

sections.heading: Retiring an entry
sections.body: Set it Inactive. It leaves the pickers, and every record that already uses it keeps showing it. Delete is for mistakes only, and only a super admin can do it.

am.title: የቅጥር ሁኔታ
am.summary: ሠራተኞች የተቀጠሩበት ሁኔታ — ቋሚ፣ ኮንትራት፣ የሙከራ ጊዜ።

sections.heading: ሁለቱ ምልክቶች
sections.body:
• Remove From Employee Lists — ይህ ሁኔታ ያላቸው ሠራተኞች በቅጾች ላይ ካሉ የሠራተኛ መምረጫዎች ይወጣሉ፤ ማንም በስህተት እንዳይመርጣቸው።
• Assigned to Terminated Employees — ሠራተኛ ሲሰናበት የሚሰጠው ሁኔታ። ሊይዘው የሚችለው አንድ ሁኔታ ብቻ ነው።

sections.heading: መዝገብን ከአገልግሎት ማስወጣት
sections.body: "Inactive" ያድርጉት። ከምርጫ ዝርዝሮቹ ይወጣል፤ ቀድሞ የተጠቀሙበት መዝገቦች ሁሉ ግን ማሳየታቸውን ይቀጥላሉ። መሰረዝ ለስህተት ብቻ ነው፤ ሊሰርዝ የሚችለውም ሱፐር አድሚን ብቻ ነው።
